messages:
anya: heads up — noticed a 2x tail latency spike in canary today when FlashAttention gets picked + paged-KV enabled. repro on small-seq traffic (avg seq 18).
ryan: ouch. is this during heavy batching or when queues are shallow?
anya: mostly when batch formation time is >20ms. our continuous-batcher ends up grouping many short requests together which increases effective seq for the kernel selector, but paged-kv page faults are kicking in. profiler snippet: 
```
GPU timeline: flash_kernel_launch +30us, sync +120us when page fault
KV pager: page_in 90ms (cold), 1.2ms (warm)
Batch stats: mean_batch_tokens=420, token_budget_target=512, avg_seq=18, effective_seq=~23
```
jun: hmm interesting — so batching ups the total tokens to fill the target, pushing FlashAttention kernels into a path that expects contiguous KV? paged-kv fragmentation causes slow page fetches.
maria: what were the kernel selection heuristics? threshold on sequence*batch_size?
anya: selector rule currently: if (seq_len >= 32 || batch_tokens >= 1024) prefer Flash; else fallback to generic. but we added a relaxed token_budget_target=512 to improve throughput and that changed batch formation.
ryan: two levers: 1) change selector to consider paged-KV mode (if paged_kv_enabled => raise flash threshold), 2) adjust continuous-batcher queue policy: lower max_batch_tokens or tighten max_wait_ms so we avoid creating large bag-of-short-seqs that trigger flash path.
anya: I ran an AB with selector change: `if paged_kv_enabled: flash_min_seq=64` — tail P95 dropped 30% on canary. but throughput lower by ~6%.
jun: can we be smarter: prefer flash only when both seq_len*batch_size > X AND estimated_kv_hot_ratio > 0.8? we can get kv_hot_ratio from pager metrics (hits/page_ins).
maria: that seems reasonable. also consider making the batcher token_budget a soft target: allow early flush if page-in latency high. maybe implement ``early_flush_on_paged_kv`` that checks recent page_in latency window.
perf-bot: [automated] captured trace 1769456701 -> /traces/1769456701 (kv,pagein,flash)
anya: I'm going to prototype two changes: (A) kernel selector respects paged_kv flag and recent page_in p50, (B) batcher adds `max_wait_ms=12` for short-seqs and `token_budget_soft=true`. will run with synthetic short-seq load (seq 8-28).
ryan: include a metric for `effective_seq_for_kernel` and `batcher_flush_reason` so we can attribute regressions. also add canary alert if p95 latency increases >15%.
jun: for experiments, add a tiny microbenchmark that simulates paged-kv cold/warm transitions and measures page_in tail (script under perf/sim/paged_kv_smoke). use `--kv-hot-ratio` param.
maria: good. one more: log actual kernel chosen per batch in the trace (flash|generic|custom) and whether paged-kv touched any new page. makes rollbacks easier.
anya: noted. I'll push a small PR with selector and batcher flags, will post perf plots tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
ryan: thanks — if it looks stable we should roll to dedicated clusters first before wide rollout.
anya: agreed.
perf-bot: [automated] scheduled job: run A/B 2000 reqs/min for 30m with trace sampling 1%
anya: tracking ticket INF-RUNTIME-312 in the rollout board.
